blocks.x: I didn’t know any of the musicians except David Pitch...
...who was right next to me in the studio. He was in the next booth, and I was by myself at the piano. The other musicians were coming from the other room, and I didn’t know
So it was in the way...
How many times have you listened to that? Once? I don’t know...
Well, yeah. A couple of times.
